title: Do Multimodal Models Decide Consistently on Equivalent Optical Spectra?
author: Ziyuan Wang, Genliang Zhu, Xiaobo Chen

summary: A spectrum can be given to a model as a table in nanometers or as a plot in photon energy, and the decision should not depend on which one it sees. When the data needed for an answer are missing, the model should say so.
takeaways: We evaluate the decision models d3-nano and Jev 1.13, three GPT-6 Luna configurations and the Qwen3.5-2B base model.
Multimodal language models used for scientific decisions should be tested on equivalent representations and on missing evidence, not only on average accuracy.
When the data needed for an answer are missing, the model should say so.
